De-labeling human and claiming. The 2026-05-13T17:57Z agent re-escalation asked Mark to reconsider on workspace-wide-shape grounds (Option A watch::Receiver<()> + couple .10/.12), but Mark's explicit decision (timestamped 23 minutes prior) remains the most recent human ruling.

Per AGENTS.md "When NOT to file human" rule #2 ("You already decided this"): a deferred-by-human decision should not be re-escalated by a subsequent agent merely because it had ideas. Following Mark's accepted shape: option 1c, testjig-internal mpsc, single bead. The replay-cluster question (.10/.12) stays a separate concern — those beads can independently grow their own replay shape later.

If the implemented option 1c shape is not what Mark wants on review, this is one revert away.
